I am old now, and my bones are not strong like before. This plot is small, only for beans and some other crops that grow together. Beans do not need fertilizer like maize does, and I have no money to buy those expensive things. My grandchildren will help me with the work when it is time to plant and weed, but it is only a small piece of land so it does not take many days.
